simpletools.title: Simple Tools
simpletools.option.enableFullDurabilityB:
Grants a bonus to mining speed and damage
when tools/weapons are near full durability.
Default: true.
simpletools.option.fullDurabilityThresho:
The fraction of durability required to
trigger the bonus (e.g., 0.9 for 90%).
Default: 0.8. Allowed range: 0.8–1.0.
simpletools.option.fullDurabilityBonusMu:
The multiplier applied to speed/damage (e.g.,
1.15 for +15%). Default: 1.0. Allowed range:
1.0–1.5. Applies to Vanilla and mod tools.
1.0 means no bonus; saved values are
retained.
Repairing or renaming at the anvil without
new enchantments does not raise the item's
anvil cost. Only enchanting does. Default:
true.
simpletools.option.enableFurnaceLavaFill:
Insert one lava bucket into an empty fuel
slot or exchange one leftover bucket. An
empty bucket remains in the furnace after
burning. Default: true.
simpletools.option.enableSoulbound.toolt:
Items with Soulbound stay in their slot on
death and never drop. Off: they drop like
any item. Default: true.
simpletools.option.deathDurabilityCap.to:
Soulbound items and Death Vault returns
keep at most this much durability.
Default: 50. Allowed range: 1–2031.
simpletools.option.soulboundAnvilCost.to:
Levels for every anvil combination that
applies Soulbound. Default: 35. Allowed
range: 1–39.
simpletools.option.soulboundTraderChance:
Chance that a wandering trader sells one
Soulbound book for 24–32 diamonds.
Default: 0.05. Allowed range: 0–1.
simpletools.option.soulboundEndCityChanc:
Chance of a Soulbound book in an End City
treasure chest (after a data reload).
Default: 0.02. Allowed range: 0–1.
simpletools.option.deathVaultCostPerItem:
Future buy-back: diamonds (or Simple Money
bills) per returned item. Default: 4.
Allowed range: 1–64.
simpletools.option.deathVaultMaxPerOffer:
Future buy-back: items one offering returns
at most. Default: 3. Allowed range: 1–27.
simpletools.option.deathVaultMaxDeaths.t:
Future buy-back: deaths kept per player
(otherwise only the last). Default: 20.
Allowed range: 1–100.
simpletools.option.deathVaultRedeem.tool:
Future feature: buy lost death drops back
with an offering. Default: false (off).
